The role requires deep hardware performance architecture expertise that is entirely absent from this resume, which is centered on web platforms, TypeScript/Node.js, and general software craftsmanship.

Demonstrated low-latency/high-performance experience with DLang and async I/O at Sociomantic

concerns: No experience with SoC/IP modeling or hardware architecture
No evidence of GPU, SIMD/MIMD, or AI accelerator work
